title: Evaluation of Safety Cognition Capability in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on safety cognition for autonomous driving, including understanding commands, detecting malicious intent, resisting perceptual manipulation, and navigating secular ethical dilemmas (Egoism, Altruism, Utilitarianism).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of its investigation.
